label: Takeaway
detail: Cornerstone went 14-35 overall and 9-19 in the WHAC, then beat top seed Northwestern Ohio 7-4 in the WHAC Tournament before losing to Cleary and Indiana Tech. No 2027 roster is posted. Going by class, 69% of 2026 plate appearances and 61% of innings can return. Goodman, Meny and Ruiz, the three best batting averages among regulars, are listed seniors.

label: Method
detail: Back means a 2026 Fr., So. or Jr. on Cornerstone's roster, including redshirts. Out means listed seniors, including redshirt seniors. A senior can still have eligibility left, so this is a floor to check, not a final count. Cornerstone's 2027 roster isn't posted.

label: Season
detail: 14-35 followed 11-33 in 2025. The last winning season was 24-20 in 2022. The 9-19 WHAC record is two wins behind 2025's 11-17. Cornerstone scored 311 runs and allowed 456.

label: WHAC Tournament
detail: Rockford, Apr 30-May 1: beat Northwestern Ohio 7-4, with Burgess getting the win and Comiskey the save, then lost to Cleary 14-4 and Indiana Tech 18-9.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players listed Fr., So. or Jr. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Rupp, Eley, Dunham, Westerkamp and Griffith each made at least 29 starts at that position, and DeRose made 15. Jackson made 3 at catcher, Caliendo 7 at short and Hatcher 1 in left, so those three spots are open.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 49 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at third (Caliendo, 17), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Cornerstone used 46 different lineups in 49 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles based on class. Listed seniors made 28 of the 49 starts, so those starts are open. Franceschina, Leckrone and Hatcher have 5 starts between them, so these are role guesses, not an established rotation. No incoming pitcher has 2026 stats here.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. All five main starters also relieved, and Comiskey, Burgess and McArthur did so at least 5 times. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: Each of the 29 players with a listed hometown is plotted at that hometown. The hot zone is a density estimate over those towns, so color shows concentration, not exact locations.

label: League
detail: Cornerstone ranked 5th of 12 WHAC teams in runs per game and 6th in homers per game, but last in steals per game and walk rate. On the mound it ranked 9th in ERA and 11th in walks and hit batters per nine, and its .930 fielding percentage was last.

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. Cornerstone's numbers are from NAIA stats, which has its 49 games but a 9.50 ERA to the official 9.55, and its WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because NAIA stats has no Rochester Christian.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Cornerstone's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Hit batters
detail: The staff hit 132 batters, the most in the WHAC and 2nd most of 179 NAIA teams. Its 9.37 walks and hit batters per nine ranked 11th of 12 in the WHAC.

label: Scoring
detail: Cornerstone scored 6.35 runs a game in NAIA stats, 5th of 11 in the WHAC, and hit .274, 7th.

label: Speed
detail: 51 steals in 60 tries was 1.04 a game, last of 12 WHAC teams and 148th in the NAIA. Hoeksema had 11 with 1 at-bat, Dunham 9 and Westerkamp 8.

label: Drew Goodman
detail: Goodman hit .401 with a 1.118 OPS, and .438 with a 1.181 OPS against WHAC teams. He made first-team All-WHAC and is a listed senior.

label: League play
detail: Cornerstone went 9-19 in the WHAC and 4-14 outside it before the tournament. It hit .298 in WHAC games with a 9.38 ERA, against .274 and 9.55 overall.

label: Defense
detail: 111 errors and a .930 fielding percentage, last of 12 WHAC teams in NAIA stats. 77 of the 456 runs allowed were unearned in the official totals.

label: Late innings
detail: Leckrone had 2 saves and a 7.03 ERA. Comiskey and Kelly had 1 save each and are listed seniors.

label: Catcher
detail: Meny made 42 of the 49 starts and is a listed senior. DeRose made 4 and Jackson 3, and both are listed at catcher.

label: First base
detail: Rupp made all 32 of his starts here and hit .151. Caliendo made 7 and Jackson 6.

label: Middle infield
detail: Eley made 32 starts at second. Ruiz made 41 at short and is a listed senior. Caliendo made 7 at short and Smith 14 at second.

label: Third base
detail: Caliendo made 17 starts, DeRose 15 and Smith 10, all back by class.

label: Outfield
detail: Goodman made 48 starts in left and is a listed senior. Westerkamp made 31 in right and 16 in center, and Dunham 29 in center and 9 in right, and both are back by class. Nobody else made more than 1 start in left.

label: Designated hitter
detail: Griffith made 32 starts here and Jackson 11. Both are back by class.

label: Rotation
detail: Hoeksema made 11 starts and is back by class. Comiskey (8), Stairs (7), Burgess (6), McArthur (4) and Kelly (3) made 28 of the 49 starts and are listed seniors.

label: Bullpen
detail: Franceschina (15 relief outings), Eck (13), Leckrone (12), Weaver (12) and Floyd (10) are back by class. Kelly (10) and McArthur (7) are listed seniors.

label: Can return by class
detail: 22 of the 30 players on the 2026 roster, including Westerkamp, Eley, Dunham, Griffith and Hoeksema. The 2027 roster isn't posted, so this is by class only.

label: Listed senior hitters, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Drew Goodman, Andrew Meny, Michael Ruiz.

label: Listed senior pitchers, 10 or more innings
detail: Christian Burgess (41.2 IP), Connor Comiskey (35.2 IP), Bobby Kelly (21.1 IP), Ryan McArthur (21.1 IP), Josiah Stairs (20.1 IP).

label: Commits on record
detail: Prep Baseball Report lists 3 from the class of 2026: Luke Deister (OF, Bexley, Ohio), Jamison Harless (RHP, Anthony Wayne, Ohio) and Luke Janigian (SS, Plymouth Christian, Mich.). None is confirmed as enrolled.

label: Chuck Lowitzki, head coach
detail: 182-258-1 over 10 seasons. His bio lists 168-223-1 over his first nine, which matches the 2017 through 2025 schedule pages, and 2026 adds 14-35. His bio also lists 13 years as an assistant at Prairie Ridge in Illinois.

label: James Sackett, assistant coach
detail: His bio says he also teaches kinesiology at Cornerstone. He played at Adrian.

label: Bret Cusick, assistant coach
detail: Listed on the staff page. His bio has no details.

label: Drew Goodman
detail: First-team All-WHAC.

label: Andrew Eley
detail: Second-team All-WHAC.

label: Michael Ruiz
detail: Second-team All-WHAC.

label: Connor Comiskey
detail: WHAC Champions of Character team.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 13 of 29 list a Michigan hometown, with Kent County the most at 4. Indiana has 3, and Illinois, Florida and Colorado 2 each.

label: How players arrive
detail: 15 of 30 list a high school as their previous school, 8 another four-year school and 4 a community college. 3 list nothing. The roster lists only one previous school per player.

label: Transfers on the field
detail: Dunham came from Walters State CC, Smith from Northland, Rupp and Hatcher from Limestone, Floyd from Coker, Comiskey and Eck from Calvin, Kelly from Davenport and Franceschina from Marian.

label: Rochester Christian is missing from NAIA stats
detail: The NAIA stats team table lists 11 WHAC teams, without Rochester Christian. Cornerstone's WHAC ranks are out of those 11, while Cleary's column on this page was worked out earlier against 12. Side-by-side edges compare the two teams' actual numbers.

label: Earned runs differ by source
detail: Official stats have 379 earned runs and a 9.55 ERA. NAIA stats has 377 and 9.50, and the box scores add to 378. The league table uses NAIA stats, so its ERA and FIP sit slightly below the official line, and its .762 OPS is .763 officially.

label: Hitting gaps against published stats
detail: Season lines here are the official ones; filters add up the box scores. Official then box score: Griffith at-bats 124, 125 and strikeouts 44, 45. Smith at-bats 83, 82 and strikeouts 21, 20. Dunham sacrifice flies 0, 1 and sacrifice bunts 4, 3. Hoeksema steals 11, 10. Caught stealing: Dunham 0, 1; Caliendo 1, 2; Sorenson 2, 1.

label: Pitching gaps against published stats
detail: Official then box score: Dunham earned runs 12, 10. Every other pitching line ties, apart from the decisions noted below. The official pitcher lines add to 380 earned runs, one more than the official team total of 379.

label: Official stats are one loss short
detail: Cornerstone's schedule page shows 14-35 and 9-19, and the game log adds to that. Its stats page shows pitching decisions of 14-34 and 9-18. The Apr 9 recap gives Hoeksema a loss to Cleary, while the stats page has him at 3-5 with that game left out. This page uses 14-35, 9-19 and his published 3-5.

label: Pitcher decisions filled in from recaps
detail: Four box scores on NAIA stats list no decision. Cornerstone's recaps give them: Leckrone's win Apr 3, Hoeksema's and Stairs's losses Apr 9, and Franceschina's loss May 1. They're in the outing log. Season totals stay as published.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 9 of the 49 box scores have no usable counts. Six list every or nearly every count as 0-0: three Aquinas games on Apr 3 and Apr 7, and all three tournament games. Three list none. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats. Counts appear for about 80% of plate appearances and full pitch sequences for about 68%.

label: Roster gaps and typos
detail: Bats and throws are blank for Bellar, Eck, Pedro, Ten Eyck, Dunham and Franceschina, so pull and opposite-field shares are blank for Dunham and Ten Eyck. Pedro has no hometown or previous school, and Jackson and Stearns have no previous school. I read "Grosse Point Farms" as Grosse Pointe Farms and "Parker, Co." as Colorado.

label: 2027 roster and schedule
detail: Neither is posted. Both 2027 addresses send you to the 2026 pages, so every status here is by class.

label: Coach record
detail: Lowitzki's bio stops at 168-223-1. Adding 14-35 from the 2026 schedule gives 182-258-1, which is what this page uses.

label: Starts in the hitter table
detail: The official batting table carries pitching starts. Hoeksema shows 11 starts with 1 at-bat, and Stearns 2 with 4 at-bats. The usage tables count lineup starts from box scores instead.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and class. Cornerstone has published no depth chart. Incoming players have no 2026 stats here, so none is in a projected spot.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Cornerstone's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth. The national map runs south to show Puerto Rico.

label: Other teams on the schedule page
detail: Cornerstone's schedule page lists five WHAC Tournament games between other teams. They aren't counted.

label: Commits are third-party listings
detail: Prep Baseball Report's Michigan commitments list shows 3 from the class of 2026. I searched the web for others and found nothing current. It doesn't confirm enrollment.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 14-35, 311 runs scored and 456 allowed, and to 9-19 in WHAC games. Line scores match those run totals. Home, away and neutral records match the schedule page.

label: WHAC site
detail: whac.net refused my browser, so honors come from Cornerstone's own story and team totals from NAIA stats. Its story doesn't give positions for the All-WHAC picks.

label: Older Cleary meetings
detail: Cornerstone's history page lists 24 Cleary games back to 2017. The Vs Cleary tab starts at 2019 to match the other teams, which leaves off 7 games, all Cornerstone wins.

label: Box scores are from NAIA stats
detail: Cornerstone's site uses a different stats system, so game data comes from NAIA stats. All 49 games are there. Hitting and pitching totals tie to the official lines except for the gaps above.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 932 of Cornerstone's 1,484 at-bats (63%): 84% of balls in play, 59% of hits (242 of 407) and 99% of everything else (690 of 696). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots. A few plays read as ground outs to outfielders, such as "grounded out to cf," and they are shown as written.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

detail: Conference previews plus a Top 25 table with rank, last record and last final rank.
extra: Overview: last season and preseason context up front

detail: Each team lists transfers and high school recruits by tier, then explains fit.
extra: Recruiting tab: newcomers by route, with fit notes

detail: Returning starters, starting pitching, relievers and newcomers with prior school, then a short outlook.

extra: Returning share bars, unweighted for now

label: EvanMiya college basketball
detail: Share of minutes from returners. Returner-reliant teams beat expectations far more often than newcomer-reliant ones.
extra: Plate appearances and innings as the continuity measure

extra: Staff tab: coaching change treated as an input

label: Runs by inning
detail: Cornerstone scored most in the 4th (65 runs) and 3rd (47), and 36 in the 1st. It scored 56 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 6th, 75 runs, then 69 in the 5th.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 38 steals of second and 13 of third, all 51 published. It shows Cornerstone caught 10 times, and the official line has 9.

label: Where Cornerstone has the edge
detail: Homers per game, 0.45 to Cleary's 0.40. It's the only row on this page Cornerstone leads.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: The rest of the hitting line: .320 batting average to .274, .886 OPS to .762 and 7.69 runs a game to 6.35. On the mound, a 5.70 ERA to 9.50, and in the field .968 to .930.

label: Series
detail: Cleary won all 3 meetings in 2026. Since 2019 Cornerstone leads 10-7.

label: Apr 9: Cleary 12, Cornerstone 3
detail: Hoeksema started for Cornerstone (3.0 IP, 4 ER) and Seman for Cleary (5.0 IP, 0 ER). Dunham went 1-for-3 for Cornerstone, and Vincent went 2-for-2 for Cleary.

label: Apr 9: Cleary 7, Cornerstone 3
detail: Stairs started for Cornerstone (0.2 IP, 3 ER) and Montilla for Cleary (5.0 IP, 1 ER). Goodman went 2-for-5 for Cornerstone, and Wesley went 2-for-5 for Cleary.

label: May 1, WHAC Tournament: Cleary 14, Cornerstone 4
detail: Franceschina started for Cornerstone (2.1 IP, 3 ER) and Montilla for Cleary (3.0 IP, 0 ER). Meny went 2-for-3 for Cornerstone, and Mackay went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 49 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Caliendo has 1.94 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), and Meny has 0.67.

label: How long arms go
detail: Burgess averages 4.1 innings a start, Hoeksema 3.8 and Comiskey 3.3. Stairs averages 2.0 over his 7. Leckrone goes 2.3 per relief outing and Franceschina 1.7.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Weaver has 1.47 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and McArthur has 0.43.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Caliendo swings at the most first pitches, 55% on 98. Goodman swings at the fewest, 21% on 162.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Smith whiffs on 14% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Ruiz on 33%. On the mound, Burgess gets a whiff on 26% of swings and McArthur on 12%, among pitchers with pitch data on 100 or more batters.

label: Direction
detail: Griffith, the one left-handed hitter with 100 plate appearances, pulls 62% of balls with a direction. Goodman goes the other way on 38%. Dunham and Ten Eyck have no listed batting side, so Pull and Oppo stay blank for them.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Kelly averages 92 pitches over 3 starts, and Burgess averages 85 over 6. Stairs averages 38 over the 5 starts with a count. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
